name: Exp_F2a_AO
summary: This EA uses a multi-timeframe approach combining a higher-timeframe trend filter (daily candlestick direction) with the F2a_AO custom indicator signals on a lower timeframe (H12) to generate buy and sell entries. It opens long positions when the trend is bullish and the F2a_AO oscillator gives an up signal, and short positions when the trend is bearish and a down signal appears, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA采用多周期策略，结合高周期趋势过滤（日线K线方向）和F2a_AO自定义指标在低周期（H12）上产生的买卖信号。趋势向上时配合指标上信号开多，趋势向下时配合指标下信号开空，并设有可配置的止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是多周期趋势跟踪，使用日线级别K线的收盘价与开盘价之差判断大趋势方向。F2a_AO指标是基于三重MA过滤（MA_Filtr=3, MA_Fast=13, MA_Slow=144）的自定义振荡器，当上信号缓冲区有值时产生买入信号，当下信号缓冲区有值时产生卖出信号。入场条件要求大周期趋势方向与振荡器信号方向一致——Trend>0时才允许开多，Trend<0时才允许开空。出场条件包括止损止盈的硬性设置，以及振荡器反向信号触发平仓，还通过回溯历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来补充平仓逻辑。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额、基于净值、基于亏损占比等，默认使用固定手数模式（LOT）。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，默认0.1。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a multi-timeframe trend-following system that uses the difference between the daily candle's close and open prices to determine the macro trend direction. The F2a_AO indicator is a custom oscillator based on triple MA filtering (MA_Filtr=3, MA_Fast=13, MA_Slow=144), generating buy signals when the upper signal buffer has a value and sell signals when the lower signal buffer has a value. Entry conditions require alignment between the macro trend and oscillator direction — longs are only opened when Trend>0 and shorts only when Trend<0. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit levels, oscillator reversal signals triggering position closes, and a supplementary lookback mechanism that scans historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal for closing. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based, equity-based, loss-share-based, and free-margin-based, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT). Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 share of deposit.

pros: 多周期趋势过滤有效减少逆势交易，提高胜率
支持五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同资金管理需求
止损止盈参数明确，默认设置止盈为止损2倍，具有正期望值潜力
买卖方向可独立开关控制，适应不同市场环境
有新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线重复交易
pros_en: Multi-timeframe trend filter effectively reduces counter-trend trades and improves win rate
Five position sizing modes provide flexibility for different money management approaches
Explicit stop-loss and take-profit with default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio has positive expectancy potential
Buy and sell directions can be independently toggled for different market conditions
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same bar
cons: 趋势判断仅基于单根K线的开收盘价差，缺乏趋势确认机制，容易在震荡市中被反复止损
历史K线回溯查找平仓信号（无限循环至Bars_）可能导致性能问题，尤其在回测时
没有点差过滤和波动率过滤，在高点差或剧烈波动时仍会交易
自定义指标F2a_AO为外部依赖，无法直接审查其信号逻辑的可靠性
没有持仓检查和最大持仓限制，可能在同方向重复开仓
cons_en: Trend determination relies solely on a single bar's open-close difference, lacking trend confirmation and prone to whipsaws in ranging markets
The unlimited bar lookback loop for finding closing signals may cause performance issues, especially during backtesting
No spread filter or volatility filter — trades are executed even during high-spread or volatile conditions
The custom F2a_AO indicator is an external dependency, making it impossible to audit its signal logic reliability
No position check or maximum position limit, potentially leading to repeated entries in the same direction
improvements: 增加趋势确认机制，如多根K线趋势或ADX过滤，减少震荡市假信号
为历史K线回溯查找平仓信号增加最大回溯K线数限制，避免性能问题
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提升资金安全性
improvements_en: Add trend confirmation mechanism such as multi-bar trend or ADX filter to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Add a maximum bar lookback limit for the closing signal search loop to prevent performance degradation
Add spread filter and maximum position count limits to improve capital safety

risk_points: 历史K线回溯无上限，存在性能风险和潜在无限循环
缺乏持仓检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度集中风险
趋势判断过于简单，震荡市中容易频繁进出造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Unlimited bar lookback in closing signal search poses performance risk and potential infinite loop
Lack of position check may cause repeated entries in the same direction leading to over-concentration
Oversimplified trend determination can cause frequent whipsaw entries and consecutive losses in ranging markets
